title: CLAUDE.md
text: zucbor R package encodes decodes CBOR (RFC 8949) ordinary R vectors lists, using vendored copy TinyCBOR C library system library required. CBOR JSON’s binary counterpart — maps, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, null — plus native byte strings, exact 64-bit integers, semantic tags (dates, bignums, UUIDs). Intended properties shape every design decision: Decoding accepts raw vectors, files connections; validates structure building R object; enforces configurable depth size limits, input expected untrusted (network, IoT devices). Encoding deterministic: identical R objects produce identical bytes. Target uses: COSE WebAuthn passkey data, CWT tokens, CoAP device telemetry, IETF protocols moved JSON CBOR. fourth self-describing format family zujson, zuyaml zuxml (sibling checkouts ../). design question answered , look packages settle inventing something new — ../zujson/CLAUDE.md ../zuxml/CLAUDE.md detailed.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: zujson/zuxml built; follow unless CBOR-specific reason . Vendored sources never edited place. live src/vendor/<lib>/, byte-identical pinned upstream release, refreshed script tools/. Local configuration goes project-owned header outside vendor tree. Portable make src/Makevars: list object files OBJECTS hand (R auto-compiles src/*.c, subdirectories), GNU-make features $(wildcard) $(shell), cost SystemRequirements: GNU make. deliberately Makevars.win; Windows falls back Makevars, one list keep right. Keep .o/./.dll build tarball via .Rbuildignore. Naming: R exports use format prefix (json_parse/xml_parse → presumably cbor_*), R C internals use zu_, .Call entry points use zucbor_. Errors classed conditions, inheriting package base class (e.g. zujson_error), raised C cause known. Tests assert condition class, never message text. Heap state must survive longjmp owned R (finalized external pointers), since Rf_error(), R_CheckUserInterrupt() R allocators jump past free(). Tests self-sufficient (inputs built inside test_that()), pass shuffle = TRUE, stay serial (Config/testthat/parallel, gctorture/valgrind CI legs actually exercise C code), keep suite seconds CRAN. Prose en-GB (Language: en-GB DESCRIPTION siblings), domain terms inst/WORDLIST via spelling::update_wordlist(). Design documents live .agents/. title: Conditions raised by zucbor — zucbor-conditions
text: Every error zucbor raises carries condition class, can caught kind rather matching message, may change. Every class inherits zucbor_error.

title: Conditions raised by zucbor — zucbor-conditions
text: zucbor_invalid_argument argument unusable: input raw vector, flag TRUE FALSE, limit positive whole number within range. zucbor_parse_error input well-formed CBOR: ends early, uses reserved encoding, misplaced "break", bytes item. zucbor_invalid_error input well-formed valid: text string UTF-8, tag whose content wrong type. zucbor_deterministic_error deterministic = TRUE input RFC 8949 core deterministic encoding. zucbor_duplicate_key map key twice duplicate_keys = FALSE. zucbor_limit_error limit reached. subclasses zucbor_depth_limit, zucbor_size_limit zucbor_item_limit name one. condition raised checking input carries offset, 0-based byte offset item fault, NA validator found fault reports position; status, name underlying status, "CborErrorUnexpectedEOF". diagnostics: branch class, . limit error also carries limit, argument's name, "max_depth", limit_value. zucbor_invalid_argument condition carries arg, argument fault.

title: zucbor 0.0.0.9000
text: Package skeleton: metadata, licence build configuration. Bundles TinyCBOR 7.0 (src/vendor/tinycbor), verified byte--byte upstream release tools/verify-vendor. zucbor_info() reports bundled TinyCBOR version, ceiling nesting depth default decoding limits. cbor_validate() checks raw vector holds well-formed, valid CBOR, RFC 8742 sequence, within depth, size item limits, without building R value. Duplicate map keys refused default, compared value. deterministic = TRUE also requires RFC 8949 core deterministic encoding. Every fault classed condition inheriting zucbor_error (see ?"zucbor-conditions").
